name: @scotthuang/agent-knock-knock
changelog: Codex Send failures retain safe stage, exact decoded target, dispatch certainty, fallback outcome and RPC method/code, with durable recovery guidance. Compact List v4/v5 expose independent routing-health observations. A private 24-hour advisory cache supplies exact inventory mismatch clues without changing authorization, route selection, transport pinning or uncertain-send rules. Coordinated core 0.16.9, Pi 0.1.0-poc.17 and DSH 0.1.0-rc.21. Formal gate passed 3909 core tests, both connector gates, isolated OpenClaw compatibility, runtime validation and package dry-run. No new live delivery claim.
